profile.summary: Trybe is a community-based nonprofit rooted in Oakland's Eastlake, San Antonio and Fruitvale area. It serves youth, young adults and families in Oakland and the greater East Bay. Its work includes after-school clubs, early-childhood playgroups, mentoring, skills-building, paid internships, community events and food mutual aid.

review.notes: Trybe, Inc. is an Oakland 501(c)(3) (EIN 46-4328520) whose own site, GuideStar and ProPublica pages confirm name, location, programs (after-school clubs, mentoring, internships, playgroups, food mutual aid), phone, email, website and the mailing address; this fits the agenda's 'Trybe, Inc.' in Oakland for after-school programs. The OUSD link rests on the name, city and service match (the Oaklandside report is not among the cited sources), and the neutral summary is supported.
